verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public API for creating, updating, or activating workflows. Routines are set up conversationally, every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404, and the MCP documentation covers Lindy consuming other products' MCP servers rather than exposing workflow management to an outside agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API
